name: Shoulder Tap Push-Up
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands just outside shoulder width and your feet slightly wider than your hips.
Lower your chest smoothly toward the floor and press firmly back up to a strong straight-arm plank.
At the top, brace your abs and glutes tightly, lift one hand to tap your opposite shoulder, and plant it firmly back on the floor.
Perform the next push-up and tap with the opposite hand, continuing to alternate sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your hips level and square to the floor during every tap rather than rocking sideways.
Complete each push-up cleanly before lifting a hand off the floor.
